## Checklist

- [ ] Notebook runs from top to bottom without errors
- [ ] All dependencies included via `!pip install` cell
- [ ] No API keys or secrets hardcoded (uses environment variables)
- [ ] Follows naming convention: `NNN_descriptive_name.py`
- [ ] Uses Jupytext `py:percent` format
- [ ] Includes title and description markdown cells
- [ ] Uses dark theme styling (`plt.style.use('dark_background')`)
- [ ] Visualizations render correctly
